verdict.rationale: Apify provides a CLI for scripting/terminal control (apify-docs-3, apify-probe-4), scheduling for automated runs (apify-docs-6), an OpenAPI-backed REST API (apify-probe-2), and Actors designed as headless automation units runnable via SDKs/CLI, all consistent with CI/headless automation use. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration examples (e.g., GitHub Actions) or independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage.
